source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r, c) not in seen:
                color = grid[r][c]
                cells = {(r, c)}
                seen.add((r, c))
                stack = [(r, c)]
                while stack:
                    x, y = stack.pop()
                    for nx, ny in ((x-1, y), (x+1, y), (x, y-1), (x, y+1)):
                        if (0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and
                                (nx, ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny] == color):
                            seen.add((nx, ny))
                            cells.add((nx, ny))
                            stack.append((nx, ny))
                objects.append([color, cells])

    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for i, (color, cells) in enumerate(objects):
            others = set().union(*(obj[1] for j, obj in enumerate(objects) if j != i))
            shifted = {(r, c+1) for r, c in cells}
            if all(c+1 < w for r, c in cells) and not (shifted & others):
                objects[i][1] = shifted
                changed = True

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells in objects:
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
